title: Zoning text change for 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would amend the city zoning map to require affordable housing at a proposed development at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn. It works together with a related zoning map change to allow a six-story building with 18 apartments, five of them permanently income-restricted, and ground-floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026.
